interpretations: For each event referenced by `budget.link_to_event`, average its non-NULL `budget.amount` values; average those event averages with each event counted once; retain events above that overall average; return each retained event’s link, event average, difference from the overall average, and difference from the average of the retained event averages, ordered by the last difference descending and limited to 10 events.
queries:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_average
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(event_average) AS overall_average
    FROM event_averages
),
retained AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_average, o.overall_average
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ea.event_average > o.overall_average
),
retained_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(event_average) AS average_of_retained
    FROM retained
)
SELECT
    r.link_to_event,
    r.event_average,
    r.event_average - r.overall_average AS difference_from_overall,
    r.event_average - ra.average_of_retained AS difference_from_retained
FROM retained AS r
CROSS JOIN retained_average AS ra
ORDER BY difference_from_retained DESC
LIMIT 10;
